title: Acceptance of payment
bodyText: . A provider's failure to dispute a reduced payment by an insurer shall not constitute an implied admission that a fraudulent billing was submitted.
bodyHtml: [§431:2-407]  Acceptance of payment.  A provider's failure to dispute a reduced payment by an insurer shall not constitute an implied admission that a fraudulent billing was submitted. [L 2009, c 149, pt of §2]
